events.summary:
At 158 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from 6 miles southwest of McCook to near Oberlin.
Movement was east at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Strong thunderstorms will be near...
McCook around 205 AM CDT.

Other locations in the path of these storms include Danbury.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Yavapai County Mountains; Northern Gila County; Yavapai County Valleys and Basins; Oak Creek and Sycamore Canyons
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Northern Gila County, Yavapai County, and Oak Creek and
Sycamore Canyons.

* WHEN...From Saturday afternoon through late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...Flash flooding will be possible in creeks, normally dry
washes, and swimming holes, and over recently burned areas.
Low-water crossings could also become flooded, which would create
deadly travel conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Thunderstorms are expected to develop this afternoon and continue
through much of the weekend. With deep monsoonal moisture in
place, any stronger storm will have the potential to produce
heavy rainfall and cause flash flooding.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.

events.region: Coastal waters from Edisto Beach SC to Savannah GA out 20 NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWCHS

The National Weather Service in Charleston has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Edisto Beach SC to Savannah GA out 20 NM...

* Until 345 AM EDT.

* At 241 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located near Fripp Inlet Buoy, moving northeast at
5 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas.

* Locations impacted include...
Fripp Inlet Buoy, Fripp Island Wreck and Saint Helena Sound.
